description: data.gov.kg is an open data portal listed in data.gov.kg, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of the Kyrgyz Republic (data.gov.kg). data.gov.kg is the open data portal of the Kyrgyz Republic. It lists about 1,400 data sets in Russian and Kyrgyz from ministries, state committees, the national statistical committee, the health insurance fund and the telecommunications and electricity companies. Coverage: Kyrgyzstan. 1,410 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 30 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-kg-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
